_comment: Copy this to accounts.json and fill in your own. accounts.json is gitignored so your secrets stay local.

calendars.label: Google (personal)
calendars._how: Google Calendar > Settings > your calendar > 'Secret address in iCal format'.

calendars.label: Outlook / Waterloo
calendars._how: Outlook > Settings > Calendar > Shared calendars > Publish a calendar > ICS link.

calendars.label: Class schedule
calendars._how: Many course/schedule systems have an 'export to iCal' link.

email_accounts.label: Gmail (personal)
email_accounts._how: Gmail: enable 2FA, then create an App Password. Basic-auth IMAP works.

email_accounts.label: Outlook (NOTE: may need OAuth)
email_accounts._how: Microsoft 365 has largely disabled basic-auth IMAP. If login fails, this account needs OAuth (Microsoft Graph) — see README.
